definitions.explanation: Chicken skin as food, especially the yakitori skewer made of it. Grilled long enough to render the fat, it comes out crisp outside and chewy inside, and is a standard cheap item on an izakaya menu.

examples.japanese: {鳥皮|とりかわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二本|にほん}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{鳥皮|とりかわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧パリパリ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Chicken skin tastes better grilled until it's crispy.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鳥皮|とりかわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{落|お}ちていて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧、⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: The skin skewers here have the fat well rendered out, and they're best eaten with just salt.

notes:
Also written {鶏皮|とりかわ}, which is the more precise spelling since {鶏|とり} means chicken specifically. On menus both appear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥皮|とりかわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧: salt-grilled chicken skin
- {鳥皮|とりかわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧パリパリ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill the skin until crisp
- {鳥皮|とりかわ}⟦ポン{酢|ず}→ポン酢：11115_ponzu⟧: chicken skin with ponzu

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Yakitori cuts are ordered by name at the counter, usually by the skewer and with a choice of ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt) or ⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧ (sauce). {鳥皮|とりかわ} sits alongside もも (thigh), ⟦ねぎま→ねぎま：30551_negima⟧ (thigh and leek), and ⟦{砂肝|すなぎも}→砂肝：30550_sunagimo⟧ (gizzard) on a standard list.
